{{Conjecture|legends}}
The [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Sannus Lorrick]] owned a '''secret lab''' in the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]] that he used to carry out illegal experiments while serving as the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony's]] [[Royal Science Advisor]]. When his actions were uncovered after more than a decade, fifteen specimens&mdash;twisted and unidentified creatures that had been subjected to Lorrick's gene splicing and viral modifications&mdash;were found in the lab, and he was arrested. However, because it was impossible to identify what the creatures originally were, the authorities were unable to prove that he had been experimenting on sentient beings, and thus he was only exiled instead of imprisoned.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=codex|Doctor Sannus Lorrick}}</ref>
